Alex Kim: Kicked off the Orion silicon preview yesterday. Couple quick notes: NDA signed, lab access starts next Tue.
Maya Singh: Great — who owns the benchmark runbook? We need 1) latency p95, 2) throughput at 2048 tokens, 3) quantized compare.
Chris O'Neil: I can take runbook. Question: do we use our standard perf harness or partner's docker image?
Alex Kim: Use partner image for HW path, but wrap with our harness so results comparable. Evan (partner-bot): Upload of lab credentials complete. S3 bucket: s3://orion-preview-3456
Maya Singh: @Chris please add a section on telemetry keys and redaction. We can't share raw user prompts.
Chris O'Neil: noted. Drafting runbook now. ETA EOD Monday.
R&D Lab - Orion: Quick ask from HW team — can you provide a trimmed model (2B) and a 1k prompt set? We prefer 1k small for early runs.
Alex Kim: We'll trim and sanitize. Also propose embargo until coordinated announcement — aim for two week buffer after final numbers.
Maya Singh: Agree. Legal wants a 14-day embargo post-official sign-off. Add to the NDA addendum.
Chris O'Neil: Putting checklist: 1) runbook, 2) telemetry plan, 3) dataset sanitize, 4) lab access, 5) results template, 6) embargo clause.
Alex Kim: Who writes results postmortem? Ops + partner PM? Prefer joint doc.
R&D Lab - Orion: Partner PM will collab. We can allocate a 2-hour sync Wed to go over initial numbers.
Maya Singh: @Alex please schedule Wed 10am PT. I'll invite legal for 15 min.
Alex Kim: scheduled. Added calendar invite.
Chris O'Neil: Uploaded initial runbook draft to /drive/orion-runs/runbook-v0.md :link:
Maya Singh: Review comments incoming. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Evan (partner-bot): Reminder: lab provisioning completes at 1pm PT tomorrow.
Alex Kim: Perfect — will start the first smoke run after provisioning.
